t: You're looking at a bust of Anne Frank, a sculpture by the British sculptor Doreen Kern. It commemorates Anne, a German-born Jewish girl who became famous around the world after her death for the diary she kept. In it she described everyday life for her family in their hiding place, a secret annex in Amsterdam, from 1942 until their arrest in 1944. Her diary is why she is remembered, and this portrait keeps her face in front of passers-by.
